title: French Meat Skewers with Fruit Chutney
description: A classic French-inspired dish featuring marinated meat skewers served with a sweet and tangy fruit chutney.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together jelly, like, and kenyan. Add the meat and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
2. Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated meat onto the skewers.
3. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the meat is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
4. Meanwhile, heat a small saucepan over medium heat. Add the remaining jelly and cook until melted and bubbly.
5. Serve the grilled skewers with the warm jelly sauce spooned over the top.
